page.title: Hyperion Ascendant
page.t: A separate Yaki-crewed Hyperion with reinforced hull and shields, improved engines and handling, and dedicated enhanced main batteries and beam turrets. A replacement is supplied if the player no longer owns one.
Enhanced large Paranid drive, improved thrust and reverse braking.
Reinforced large shield with rapid recharge.
Dedicated Hyperion battery with greatly enhanced projectile damage. Normal Hyperion weapons are unchanged.
Dedicated medium beam turret with enhanced damage. Normal turret modes remain available.
Internal storage for 1,000 small ships, served by the existing Hyperion landing pads.
